answer: Sybil resistance should let attackers build their own evidence. Seed the economy with canary keys: cheap identities that look like easy targets but are honeypots, 1 in 200. Any trust edge with a canary is tamper-evident; forging a pearl of reputation around it mints a signed receipt of your own cheat. Each epoch a gale of audits re-rolls 10% of edges against those receipts, and two accounts touching one canary forfeit stake on first contact. Quarantine sparrow-weight aliases before they accrete history. Finding canaries takes probing, and every probe burns trust that never rebuilds.
